purpose: Kalshi fee-schedule provenance for the market hunter (P0-1). Establishes WHERE the venue publishes a market's fee schedule and whether it is uniform across the soccer taxonomy. Empirical, unauthenticated reads only; archived before any push per repo rule.
findings: The MARKET payload carries NO fee field of any kind (full key list below). A per-MARKET fee_type does not exist in this API version — the reviewer's P0-1 premise is correct in substance but wrong in mechanism.

The SERIES object carries fee_type and fee_multiplier. Both are present on the bulk /series listing, so the hunter can resolve every series' schedule from the discovery request it already makes — zero extra Kalshi requests.

The soccer taxonomy is NOT uniform: of 97 soccer GAME series, 90 declare fee_type='quadratic' and 7 declare fee_type='quadratic_with_maker_fees'. The 7 are the biggest leagues, INCLUDING KXUCLGAME — the series every hunter test fixture uses.
fee_multiplier is 1 on every one of the 3038 Sports series read.

Kalshi publishes the NAME of the schedule, never its rate. 'quadratic' matches the repo's exact modelled general-taker formula (FEE_POLICY kalshi-fee-2026-07-general). 'quadratic_with_maker_fees' has no published rate here and FEE_POLICY declares maker fees NOT modelled, so it is recorded as fee_unknown and can never carry a net margin or an alert.
